title: AI Merging Games idea, got inspired by Minecraft/Elden Ring AI or mods (I honestly dont understand but amazed) but would love to see this concept applied through other types of games
author: Due-Battle-5847
selftext:
So I saw the AI Merging games video and I was wondering if it would be possible to try to have the BG3 Battle system with the turn-based combat, merged with other games like Elden Ring, as there are all the mobs that have their own type of attacks and moveset.

Refering to this video! [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hD-tyU47f84&t=10s&pp=ygUQYWkgbWVyZ2luZyBnYW1lcw%3D%3D](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hD-tyU47f84&t=10s&pp=ygUQYWkgbWVyZ2luZyBnYW1lcw%3D%3D)

If they can translate minecraft/BO/Skate into elden ring/skyrm/MW with spawning mobs and all, I wonder if they might be able to get the ai to somehow implement a turn-based mode for an area where all the npcs/mobs would have their own set entire character sheet that has their level, their in game abilities, ac, movement sped, actions, potions and so on and implement a turn-based combat mode. There would definitely be so much that would need to be taking into account since how the environment plays a role as well like throwing, picking up, dipping, etc,  but i think it would be an awesome project! 

  
I just also wanted to have a mini brain storm but feel free to add more in the comments, I wanna know if theres others with a similar idea! 

Difficulties I could think of: 

\- Camera angles from out of turn base to turn base (bird's-eye view vs 3rd and 1st view)

\- Elemental effects

[https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Resistances](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Resistances)

[https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Creatures\_and\_Enemies#tabber-Enemies\_by\_Weakness](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Creatures_and_Enemies#tabber-Enemies_by_Weakness)

\- sneaking while combat is happening

\- classes of all the mobs (enemy type, beast, human, cause theres so many different types of enemies in Elden ring) 

[https://baldursgate3.wiki.fextralife.com/Enemies](https://baldursgate3.wiki.fextralife.com/Enemies)

[https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Creatures\_and\_Enemies](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Creatures_and_Enemies)

\- types of actions that can be done, (attacks, spells, weapons) how that would translate if Elden rings actions can be translated to BG3 

[https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Actions](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Actions)

\- classes and levelling up, ready spells, actions, skill tree 

\- animations of actions 

\- balancing enemy AI/companion AI, Summons AI

\- Theres probably so many other things but leave a comment im curious to see if others can come up with other ideas!   


Opportunities I could think of: 

\- approaching combat will be more creative

\- more opportunities to see all different abilities without sucking in the RT combat ( Ionly had 80 hours in Elden Ring as a Samurai, so by seeing other abilities it would motivate me to try out different classes in this hard-ass game.) 

\- a bigger understanding of the other game's mobs as you would technically be able to read their character card and info 

\- Elden ring abilities/actions would be awesome (

Idk it was just a thought and an idea that I think would be a pretty fun way to play Elden ring so its a more chiller version and also the lore from it would be more appealing for the chill gamer lol. I spent loads of time in BG3 with character creation, coming up with builds and testing out all of the classes and spells, but i would love it if we can use AI to try to translate Elden Ring into BG3s battle system! 

  
I also do not understand any of the AI stuff but wow the jump is wild and scary. Hopefully someone sees this and tries to do it or bring me into it lol.

comments.author: kitxchten
comments.body:
I'm going to try to apply a bit of rigor here

This desire would create something that eliminates all authorial intent of the original game. The "lore" of Elden Ring is entirely diegetic, based largely on descriptions of items you acquire through struggle. If you remove the context of struggle from the formula, you also lose your relationship to the lore that makes it transcend a Wikipedia transcript

Furthermore, the concept of realtime is fundamental to the From formula (you can't even pause, remember). That's why it's an animation-based game, why the motion/attack animations are so beautiful and considered, and why this desire would eliminate the other half of game design Fromsoft is known for: the resolution that, at the end of the game, your every combat victory was performed in relationship to your in-the-moment awareness

The ability to put an Elden Ring coat of paint on BG3 is probably more what you'd like to see. This desire is more that game than this game
